notes: Version 3.6 corrects the description of Axiom A3 of the Foundation paper in the text introducing hypothesis H-ext, in the remark that follows it and in the status remark: A3 is not a non-factorisability axiom. The Foundation paper obtains non-factorisability of the admissible fibre only under an additional sector reading of A3, not derived (Foundation version 2.6, Lemma 5.6). The admissible coherence extensivity H-ext remains an explicit open hypothesis, distinct from that reading and not implied by it. Condition (C5) and hypothesis H-ext no longer refer to Axiom A3 for the independence of sectors: (C5) refers to the definition given in H-ext, which defines admissibly independent sectors by its own clause, the absence of any cross-admissibility constraint coupling them after projection locking. The content and status of H-ext and all theorems and results of the paper are unchanged.
